Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vinod - 34 years, son
Look: light beard, green T-shirt
2. Meenakshi - 26 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Neeta - 60 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Hema - 27 years, friend
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
4. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror

Scene 1: The terrace - Day

[Meenakshi stands on the terrace. Vinod stands near her.]

Vinod: "What lovely weather!"

[Meenakshi hangs the wet clothes on the line.]

Vinod (laughing): "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Vinod stands by the road. Neeta and Meenakshi stand near him.]

Vinod: "So, here we are!"

[Vinod starts his scooter and rides off.]

Neeta: "This is amazing!"

[Vinod drives the car to the office.]

Vinod: "And then?"

[Vinod gets out of the car.]

Vinod (laughing): "Slowly, take it easy."

Scene 3: The main road - Day

[Vinod stands on the road. Neeta and Hema stand near him.]

Hema: "What a nice place."

[Vinod's bike skids on the wet road and he falls off.]

Vinod: "And then?"

[Vinod's car crashes into a pole.]

Hema: "Exactly right."

[A dog runs in front of Vinod's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Vinod (happily): "That was fun!"

Scene 4: The bathroom - Day

Neeta: "So, here we are!"

[Vinod shaves in front of the mirror.]

Neeta: "What a day to remember!"
